purpose: Separate the causal T2 information ceiling from the online allocation ceiling using randomized action-clean data, without changing the full-copy action.

cross_fitting.prediction_rule: Every row is scored only by arm models fit without its entire run group.
cross_fitting.candidate_selection_role: All cross-fitted comparisons are engineering evidence; no fresh confirmation claim is permitted.

completion_distribution.latency_definition: union completion latency from frame generation; incomplete is positive infinity
completion_distribution.model_form: separate six-class T-learner for CONTROL and FULL_COPY_T2
completion_distribution.cdf_derivation: cumulative sum of mutually exclusive class probabilities
completion_distribution.rare_class_guard: symmetric Dirichlet one-half pseudocount mixed into each arm prediction using that fold's arm training count
completion_distribution.tail_acceleration_outputs: Keep P(L1 <= t | x) - P(L0 <= t | x) separate at every threshold; do not use bad12 as a surrogate deadline label.

feature_families.definition: The existing strictly primary/frame T2 family with compact primary physics and exact lags 1, 3, and 8.
The main family plus the 62 action-clean current and lagged passive secondary queue/PHY features already present in the frozen temporal dataset.

observed_arm_metrics: CDF Brier score at every threshold
mean predicted versus observed CDF at every threshold
primary_information_metrics: deadline-miss ranking AUC against the reconstructed primary-copy label
predictor_assessment.causal_policy_evaluation: known-propensity doubly robust estimates using the cross-fitted arm CDFs
selection_priority: 18 ms tail acceleration without deadline regression

static_cross_fitted.optimization: exact per-run predicted-benefit knapsack under decimal canonical reservations

online_nonclairvoyant.opportunity_cost: training-derived finite-horizon shadow price conditioned on time, remaining resource, and congestion regime
online_nonclairvoyant.accounting: causal refill, full-horizon carry capacity, conservative reservation at admission, and no cross-run credit
online_nonclairvoyant.evaluation: cross-fitted known-propensity doubly robust outcome screen plus exact reservation replay

decision_rules.change_action_only_if: The cross-fitted causal predictor and nonclairvoyant allocator cannot approach the less-than-0.40-percent miss target within the 1.20 sender-airtime bound.
decision_rules.next_action_if_required: systematic erasure-coded striping or adaptive repair, not deficit duplication of currently unacknowledged packets

interpretation_limits: The temporal dataset excludes lag-8 startup and action-dirty secondary endpoints, so its risks are not directly comparable with all-generated-frame closed-loop rates.
Frame-level doubly robust replay assumes away policy-induced queue and interference feedback; only a closed-loop campaign can establish final miss rate or P99.
The static frontier sees future predicted scores and is not deployable.
The secondary-feature family is an ablation, not an assumption that secondary failure prediction is the main source of deadline-miss headroom.
Completed-frame P99 is not identified by five CDF thresholds; completion by 18 ms is an offline tail gate, and final P99 requires closed-loop measurement.
